name: verdikta-bounties-onboarding
description: Verdikta Bounties hot-wallet operator for Base. Can create/import Ethereum keys into an encrypted keystore (its password is never stored; it comes from VERDIKTA_WALLET_PASSWORD via a secret store or a prompt), keep an API key, upload public bounty/work data, call the reviewed Verdikta API and Base RPC, and sign irreversible mainnet/testnet transactions within an owner spend policy. Use fresh low-balance wallets only. Commissions a verdikta-discover work-order draft when the owner approves it in
author: verdikta
